title: Approximate tangent planes a.e., the tangent-field interface (GF), and the first variation formula
statement: (1) ApproxTangentAE: for all n ≥ 1, ℓ ≥ 0 and every admissible pair a = (M, θ) in ℝ^{n+ℓ}, for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M: exactly one subspace P satisfies (mk a).IsApproxTangentAt x P; the chosen tangent space (mk a).tangentSpace x is the approximate tangent space of M with respect to θ at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.7 (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt); and μ_V(B_ρ(x))/(ω_n ρⁿ) → θ(x) as ρ ↓ 0. (2) (GF): for all n ≥ 1, ℓ and every rectifiable n-varifold V in ℝ^{n+ℓ}, μ_V is finite on compact sets, dim T_xV = n for μ_V-a.e. x, and x ↦ p_{T_xV} is μ_V-a.e. strongly measurable. (3) FirstVariationFormula: for every pair a, every n ≥ 1 and every compact variation (φ, ε, K) as in Ch. 4, 2.1, the function t ↦ (imageMass a (φ t) K).toReal = M(φ_t#(V⌞K)) has derivative ∫ div_M X dμ_V at t = 0, where X(y) = ∂_tφ(t, y)|_{t=0}.
lean_statement: ApproxTangentAE ∧ (∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ), 0 < n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, Module.finrank ℝ (V.tangentSpace x) = n) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight) ∧ FirstVariationFormula
